I decided to double up on reel meals since I’m behind with editing… Loaded Chicken Twice Baked Potato!!! Nuff said. I wish y’all could taste through the screen omg. I tore this meal DOWN ——————————————— RECIPEEEE! If y'all been following me y'all know I do not measure but i'll try my best.  Ingredients:  - Russet Potatoes  - Heavy Cream - Colby Jack Cheese - Seasonings for taste (in step list)  - Sharp Cheddar Cheese  - Unsalted Butter  - Vegetable Oil - Broccoli (optional for filling) - Aluminum Foil - Garlic Paste  - Sour Cream - EVOO - Cubed Chicken (cut up breasts or tenderloin)  [Baked Potato] * 1st you want to prep your potatoes. You're basically making a baked potato. Take your potatoes (russet) and wash them. Then cover with oil (I used vegetable oil) and individually wrap each potato tightly in aluminum foil. Bake in the oven at 400 degrees F for about an hour. * Once potatoes are soft and cooked completely remove the foil and cut down the middle of each potato, hot dog style. Scoop out the inside of the potato and put into an empty mixing bowl. To the mixing bowl you're going to add 1 stick of unsalted melted butter, tbsp of garlic paste, parsley, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp garlic salt, cooked broccoli, 1/2c grated sharp cheddar cheese, pepper, and 2 tbsp sour cream. Mix together and scoop filling back into potatoes. [Sauce]  * Add 1 tbsp butter to pan, 1 tsp garlic paste and parsley and melt down. Add about 1cup of heavy cream and let cook for 5 minutes to thicken. Add pepper, onion powder and lawrys seasoning salt to season. Add colby jack cheese (about 1cup) and mix until sauce is thick and consistency you like. [Chicken]  * I used chicken beasts and cut into cubes. Add EVOO and seasoned with parsley, onion powder, garlic powder and adobo. Cooked in a greased pan until done. * Add thin layer of sauce on potatoes, then chicken, then sauce again and finally top with more cheese and bake on 125 until cheese is melted. #loadedpotato #twicebakedpotato #chickenloadedpotato #cookingtiktok #chefd #fivestarmeals #dinnerideas #dinnerinspo

videos.caption: This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

The one recipe of mine you NEED to make, ONE PAN MARRY ME CHICKEN ORZO. Life changing! 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut up into cubes 2 tb olive oil 4-5 cloves garlic, mashed 3/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes, in oil, drained 2 tsp italian seasoning 2 tsp paprika 1/2 tsp kosher salt 1 tsp ground black pepper 1 cup orzo 2 3/4 cups chicken broth (or water) 3/4 cup full fat coconut milk or heavy cream 2 large handfuls fresh spinach 3/4 cup parmesan cheese, freshly grated Pat chicken dry and cut into cubes. Add olive oil to a large, deep skillet over medium-high heat. Once the pan is hot, add the chicken. Stir and cook for 2-3 minutes until the edges start to cook. Add in the sun dried tomatoes, garlic, italian seasoning, paprika, salt & black pepper. Cook for 3-4 minutes more, then add the orzo and broth and stir well. Reduce heat to medium. Cover the skillet and cook for 12 minutes, removing the cover every few minutes to stir and ensure nothing sticks to the bottom of the pan. Once the orzo is cooked through, add the coconut milk/cream and spinach and stir another minute until the spinach is wilted, then add in the parmesan cheese and stir once more. Remove from heat, plate and enjoy!   #20minutedinner #easyrecipes #marrymechicken #valentinesdaydinner #easydinner

99 curve goals☠️ 🏆 UEFA Champions League — Full Overview ⚽ What It Is The UEFA Champions League (UCL) is the most prestigious club football competition in Europe, organized by UEFA (Union of European Football Associations). It brings together the best football clubs from European leagues to compete for the title of the best team in Europe. 🏁 History Founded: 1955 (originally called the European Cup) Renamed: UEFA Champions League in 1992 The original tournament was only for league champions, but today it includes the top teams from each country (for example, 1st–4th places in the Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, etc.). 🧩 Format of the Tournament 1. Qualifying Rounds Smaller clubs from lower-ranked European leagues play several knockout rounds in summer to reach the group stage. 2. Group Stage 32 teams divided into 8 groups (A–H), with 4 clubs in each group. Each team plays 6 matches (home and away). The top two teams from each group advance to the Round of 16, while the 3rd place drops into the Europa League. 3. Knockout Stage Round of 16 → Quarterfinals → Semifinals → Final Two-legged ties (home and away) until the final. The Final is a single match on neutral ground (decided before the season starts). 🌍 Qualification Example Each country has a certain number of slots based on UEFA’s coefficient rankings: England, Spain, Germany, Italy → 4 direct places in group stage France, Portugal, Netherlands → fewer direct spots Smaller nations → enter through qualification rounds 🏅 Trophy & Rewards The famous “Big Ears” trophy (because of its large handles) The winner qualifies for: UEFA Super Cup FIFA Club World Cup Automatic spot in next season’s group stage Prize money: over €100 million possible for the winner (including bonuses and TV rights) 🔥 Most Successful Clubs Club	Country	Titles Real Madrid	🇪🇸 Spain	🏆 15 AC Milan	🇮🇹 Italy	🏆 7 Bayern Munich	🇩🇪 Germany	🏆 6 Liverpool	🇬🇧 England	🏆 6 Barcelona	🇪🇸 Spain	🏆 5 Ajax	🇳🇱 Netherlands	🏆 4 Manchester United	🇬🇧 England	🏆 3 🧠 Interesting Facts Real Madrid won the first five European Cups (1956–1960). Barcelona (2009 & 2015) and Bayern Munich (2013 & 2020) achieved the treble (League + Cup + Champions League). The anthem (“Champions League Theme”) is sung before every match — it’s based on Handel’s Zadok the Priest. It’s watched by over 400 million people each season world-wide. #footbal #goals #curve

Chicken broccoli cheddar soup 🧀🥦🍂 felt a breeze outside so it’s finally soup season! Full recipe below  Ingredients - 2 tablespoons olive oil - 1 medium onion diced - 5 garlic cloves, minced - 1 shallot, minced  - 3 carrots, shredded - 4 slices bacon, diced - 4oz diced pancetta  - 2 cups chicken broth  - 1 cup whole milk - 1 cup heavy cream - 2 chicken breast, butterflied & shredded  - 4 cups broccoli florets, chopped - 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 2 tsp dried thyme - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder - 1 packet of sazon - Salt and pepper to taste - 3 tbsp all-purpose flour - 2 tbsp butter Instructions  - In a large pan on medium high heat add olive oil and seasoned chicken breast. Cook for 4 minutes on each side. Pour in chicken stock, cover and cook until done and tender enough to shred. Shred chicken and sit aside - Add bacon and pancetta to large pot, cook until done remove from the pot. Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

Dredge in seasoned flour mixture, pressing to coat well. Rest the floured chicken for 10 minutes before frying  - Fry in batches 4–6 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Drain on a wire rack or paper towels.  - In a small saucepan combine honey, butter, and hot sauce. Mix until well combined. Let it simmer for 3-4 minutes then remove from heat - Brush chicken with hot honey sauce on both sides - Slice buns horizontally and brush with butter, place into a pan on medium high heat and toast until slightly golden brown.  - Mix melted butter, parsley and garlic powder. Braised Chicken Legs with Rice, Potatoes & Veggies🍗 Ingredients * 1 package chicken drumsticks (6–7 pieces) * 1-2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp garlic powder * 2 tsp onion powder * 2 tsp paprika * ½ tsp cumin * 1 jalapeño, diced * ½ red onion, diced * 1 tbsp sun-dried tomato paste * 1 tbsp @Loisa sofrito * 5–6 garlic cloves, minced * 4 cups chicken stock * 1 (8 oz) can tomato sauce * Small potatoes, halved (about 10–12 baby potatoes) * 1 zucchini, diced * Cooked white rice, for serving (let me know if you guys want my rice recipe) Instructions: 1. Clean the chicken with vinegar, then pat completely dry with paper towels. 2. Season the chicken with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and cumin. Toss until evenly coated. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven or deep skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Brown the chicken for 2–3 minutes per side until golden. It doesn’t need to be cooked through. Remove and set aside. 5. In the same pot, add the diced jalapeño and red onion. Cook for about 5 minutes until softened. 6. Stir in the sun-dried tomato paste and cook for 30 seconds. 7. Add the Loisa Sofrito and minced garlic. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant. 8. Pour in the chicken stock and tomato sauce, stirring to combine. Bring to a gentle boil. 9. Return the chicken to the pot. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 1 hour, or until the chicken is fall-apart tender and the sauce has reduced. 10. About 20 minutes before the chicken is done, add the halved potatoes and diced zucchini. Continue simmering until the potatoes are fork-tender and the zucchini is cooked. 11. Serve over fluffy white rice and spoon plenty of the sauce over the top. #chickenlegs #braised #onepotmeals #cookwithme

INGREDIENTS Chicken & Marinade 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs 1 lemon, zested ⅛ cup soy sauce ¼ cup maple syrup 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tbsp smoked paprika Glaze 2 tbsp butter 4 cloves garlic, minced ½ cup maple syrup ⅓ cup soy sauce 2 tbsp rice vinegar 3 tsp Momofuku chili oil 1 tsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (slurry) INSTRUCTIONS 1.In a bowl add chicken thighs and season with soy sauce, maple syrup, lemon zest, garlic powder, and smoked paprika, coat well. 2.Preheat the air fryer to 400°F. Place thighs in a single layer and cook for 15 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through (165°F internal temp). 3.Make glaze: In a saucepan, melt butter. Add garlic and cook until fragrant. Stir in maple syrup, soy, vinegar, and chili. Simmer for 3-4 minutes. crispy chicken caesar salad croissants 🥗🥐 these over the wraps anyday omg 😣     recipe:   ingredients- 4 thin sliced chicken breasts 1 cup all-purpose flour (120g) seasonings (to taste)- salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, italian seasoning, chili powder, kinder bold chicken seasoning blend for the wet mixture- 2 eggs 2–3 tbsp heavy cream (30–45g) 1–2 tbsp pickle juice for the coating- 1½ cups panko breadcrumbs (90g) 2–3 tbsp grated parmesan for the caesar salad- romaine lettuce, chopped croutons extra parmesan other ingredients- 4 large croissants oil for frying garlic butter- 2 tbsp melted butter (28g) 1 clove garlic, minced parsley extra parmesan caesar dressing- 1 cup mayo (240g) ½ cup finely grated parmesan (50g) 2–3 cloves garlic, minced 2 tbsp lemon juice (30g) 1 tbsp dijon mustard (15g) 1 tsp worcestershire sauce ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ cup olive oil (60g) 2–4 tbsp water (to thin if needed) instructions: season the chicken generously with your spices. in one bowl, mix the flour with any remaining seasoning. in another bowl, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, and pickle juice. in a third bowl, combine the panko and parmesan. coat each piece of chicken in the flour, then the egg mixture, then the panko mixture. let the breaded chicken rest for 5–10 minutes. fry in oil over medium heat until golden brown and cooked through, about 4–5 minutes per side. transfer to a wire rack. for the dressing, whisk together the mayo, parmesan, garlic, lemon juice, dijon, worcestershire, salt, and pepper. slowly whisk in the olive oil, then add water until smooth and pourable. toss the chopped romaine with some of the caesar dressing. add croutons and extra parmesan. slice the croissants in half and spread a little caesar dressing on both sides. add the crispy chicken, top with the caesar salad mixture, and sprinkle with more parmesan. mix together the melted butter, garlic, and parsley. brush the tops of the croissants with the garlic butter and finish with extra parmesan. serve immediately and enjoyyyy    #caesarsalad #crispychicken #croissant #Recipe #EasyRecipe

⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. When ready to eat, microwave the rice with a wet paper towel first to get it steamed, then add in your meat and microwave till warm, and finally add your salad to preserve the crunch and enjoy! 📩 Save this Soy Glazed Chicken recipe to make for later! #highprotein #lowcaloriemeals #mealprep #mealplan #healthyrecipe #weightlossmeals #asianfood #chicken

Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍓🤎 Perfect brownies for summer!  (recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients:  10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: Strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top & drizzle)  Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 325°F and line/grease an 8x8 pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!  #bakingrecipe #brownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #recipe

Hot Honey Chicken Pasta 🍯🔥 the viral recipe with over 60+ million views, 20/10 hits every time! Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. Top creamy pasta with hot honey chicken and extra sauce if desired and enjoy :) #hothoneychickenpasta #hothoney #chickenpasta #pasta #fypシ

8 easy freezer chicken marinades 🌿 Honey Garlic Chicken Ingredients: 1–1.5 lb chicken 1/4 cup honey 1/4 cup soy sauce 3–4 cloves garlic, minced 1–2 tbsp olive oil 1–2 green onions, sliced Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. Thaw overnight, then cook in crockpot (low 4–6 hours) or on stovetop until fully cooked. Serve with rice and veggies. ⸻ Lemon Chicken Ingredients: 1–1.5 lb chicken 1/4 cup olive oil Juice of 1–2 lemons 2–3 cloves garlic 1 tsp Italian seasoning Salt & pepper 1–2 lemon slices Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. Thaw overnight, then bake at 375°F or cook on stovetop until fully cooked. Serve with rice, potatoes, or veggies. ⸻ Greek Style Chicken Ingredients: 1–1.5 lb chicken 1/2 cup plain Greek yogurt 2 tbsp olive oil Juice of 1 lemon 2 cloves garlic 1–2 tsp oregano Salt & pepper 1/4 red onion, thinly sliced 1-2 tbsp dill  Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. Thaw overnight, then grill, bake, or cook on stovetop until fully cooked. Serve with rice, pita, or a salad. ⸻ Basil Balsamic Chicken Ingredients: 1–1.5 lb chicken 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar 2 tbsp olive oil 1–2 tbsp honey 2 cloves garlic Fresh basil (or 1 tsp dried) Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. Thaw overnight, then bake at 375°F or cook on stovetop until fully cooked. Serve with pasta, rice, or roasted veggies. Pineapple Teriyaki Chicken  Ingredients: 2–3 lbs chicken breasts or thighs 1 cup teriyaki sauce ½ cup pineapple juice 1 tbsp soy sauce 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 tsp ginger Pineapple chunks Green onion + sesame seeds Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. When ready to cook: Thaw overnight in the fridge. Cook on low 5–6 hours in the crockpot or bake at 400°F for 25–30 minutes. Serve over rice with broccoli. ⸻ Pesto Mozzarella Chicken  Ingredients: 2–3 lbs chicken breasts 1 cup pesto ¼ cup olive oil 2 cloves garlic, minced Cherry tomatoes Mozzarella pearls Salt + pepper Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. When ready to cook: Thaw overnight in the fridge. Bake at 400°F for 25–30 minutes or grill until fully cooked. Serve with pasta, rice, or roasted vegetables. ⸻ Honey Mustard Chicken  Ingredients: 2–3 lbs chicken breasts or tenders ½ cup honey ⅓ cup Dijon mustard 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder Salt + pepper Parsley or thyme Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. When ready to cook: Thaw overnight in the fridge. Bake at 400°F for 25–30 minutes or air fry at 375°F for 15–18 minutes. Serve with potatoes or green beans. ⸻ Buffalo Ranch Chicken  Ingredients: 2–3 lbs chicken breasts or tenders ¾ cup buffalo sauce ¼ cup ranch 1 tbsp cream cheese (optional) 1 tsp garlic powder Salt + pepper Green onion Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. When ready to cook: Thaw overnight in the fridge. Cook on low 5–6 hours in the crockpot for shredded chicken or bake at 400°F for 25–30 minutes. Serve over rice, in wraps, or with roasted potatoes. #freezermeals #chickenmarinade #freezermealprep #easymealprep #mealprepideas

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

FLATBREAD WITH BUTTER CHICKEN #food #recipe #chicken #butterchicken #flatbread CHICKEN MIXTURE 25 g unsalted butter 20 ml sunflower oil 600 g chicken thighs, cut into cubes 5 g garam masala (1⅔ tsp) 2 g ground coriander (⅔ tsp) 2 g ground cumin (⅔ tsp) 3 g garlic powder (1 tsp) 4 g onion powder (1⅓ tsp) 2 g cayenne pepper (⅔ tsp) 30 g tomato paste 50 ml water 100 ml heavy cream 15 g honey 1 chicken stock cube 100 g grated cheese (Gouda) DOUGH 350 g all-purpose flour 50 g herb cream cheese 4 g salt (⅔ tsp) 6 g baking powder 170 ml water EXTRA cheese slices Heat the butter and sunflower oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken thighs, garam masala, ground coriander, ground cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, and cayenne pepper. Fry for 5–6 minutes. Add the tomato paste, water, cream, and honey. Mix well and let simmer for 5–7 minutes until the sauce has slightly thickened. Crumble the chicken stock cube over the pan. Add the grated cheese and stir until creamy. Remove from the heat and let the chicken mixture cool completely. Place the flour, baking powder, herb cream cheese, salt, and water in a large bowl. Knead for 10–12 minutes until smooth. Cover and let the dough rest for 10 minutes. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces of about 70 g each and shape into balls. Roll out a dough ball into a circle. Place a slice of cheese on one half and spread about 90 g of the chicken mixture on top. Lightly moisten the edges, fold the dough closed, and press the edges firmly to seal. Place the filled dough on a sheet of parchment paper. Heat a heavy-bottomed frying pan with a little oil. Cook the breads over medium-high heat until golden brown and cooked through on both sides. Tips Don’t cut the chicken too small. Cubes of about 2 cm give a better bite. Let the mixture thicken well. The sauce should be creamy and firm, not runny like a curry. Let it cool completely. A warm filling makes the dough soft and hard to seal. Letting the dough rest is important. Those 10 minutes make it more elastic and easier to roll out. Use any cheese you like. You can also bake these breads in the oven. Preheat the oven to 200°C (390°F) and bake for 15–20 minutes (brush with oil or butter). Add salt to taste. Preparation Time Chicken mixture preparation & cooling: 20 minutes Dough preparation & resting: 25 minutes Cooking: 10–15 minutes

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

videos.caption: Here is my One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta Dinner 🤤🍝 full recipe on my website.  Crispy on the outside, juicy and full of flavor chicken over a rich, creamy, cheesy pasta. Easy comfort food made in one pot! No mess no stress dinner 😊 One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta:  Ingredients Chicken 2 chicken breasts 1 tbsp olive oil 1–2 tbsp butter 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder Salt and black pepper, to taste Pasta & Sauce 8 oz dry rigatoni 24 oz heavy cream 24 oz chicken broth (add more if needed) 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1–2 cups shredded cheese of your choice (I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar) Optional Garnish Fresh parsley, chopped Grated Parmesan cheese Red pepper flakes Instructions Season the chicken: Coat the chicken breasts with olive oil, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, sweet paprika, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Let the chicken marinate in the refrigerator for 15–30 minutes for the best flavor. Cook the chicken: Heat a large pot or skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 2–3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest. Cook the pasta: In the same pot, add the rigatoni, heavy cream, chicken broth, 1–2 tbsp butter, and seasonings. Stir everything together, cover, and let the pasta simmer until al dente, stirring occasionally. Add more broth or cream if needed while the pasta cooks. Add the cheese: Once the pasta is cooked, add your shredded cheese and stir until melted and creamy. I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar, but feel free to use whatever cheese you have in the fridge. Finish and serve: Slice the rested chicken and place it on top of the creamy pasta. Chicken alfredo tacos 🌮  For the chicken 1 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  1/2 tsp Italian seasoning  2 tbsp lemon juice  2 tbsp oil for marinating + more for cooking For the Alfredo sauce: 2 tbsp butter 1 tbsp all purpose flour  2 cloves fresh garlic, minced  1 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream Salt to taste  1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1/2 cup milk 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese, freshly grated  To assemble  15-16 mini tacos 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for lightly frying the tacos 1/4 cup parsley, freshly chopped for garnish  Method  Marinate the chicken with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, lemon juice, and oil for 20–30 minutes. Fill each tortilla with mozzarella, the chicken Alfredo mixture, and a little more mozzarella. Fold and pan-fry until golden and crispy on both sides. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with extra Alfredo sauce for dipping. #recipe #tacos #alfredochicken

Sweet chili garlic chicken tenders. Ingredients  1 lb chicken tenders For the wet batter: 1 1/2 cup butter milk 2 tbsp lemon juice  2 tbsp soy sauce  1/4 cup hot sauce  Salt to taste 1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tbsp onion powder  1 tbsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp black pepper powder  For the dry batter: 2 cups all purpose flour 1/2 cup corn starch  2 tbsp baking powder  Salt to taste 1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tbsp onion powder  1 tbsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp black pepper powder  For the sweet chili garlic sauce  1/3 cup honey  2 tbsp ketchup  1 tbsp soy sauce sauce  1 tbsp fresh lemon juice  1/4 cup hot sauce  1 tbsp chili garlic sauce  3 cloves garlic, minced Salt to taste 2 tbsp butter, cold For the ranch dressing  1/2 cup mayonnaise 1/4 cup sour cream 2 tbsp buttermilk 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp dried parsley 1/4 tsp dried dill 1/4 tsp black pepper 1 tsp lemon juice Salt to taste Method: Marinate chicken with buttermilk, lemon juice, soy sauce, hot sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt. Mix well, cover, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or 2–4 hours for the best flavor and tenderness. In a bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, baking powder, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt. Remove chicken from the buttermilk mixture and coat well in seasoned flour, pressing the flour onto the chicken. Dip back into the reserved buttermilk marinade, then coat again in flour, pressing and squeezing the flour onto the chicken for a thick, craggy coating. Let rest for 5–10 minutes. Heat oil to 350°F and fry in batches for 4–6 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden and the chicken reaches 165°F. Transfer to a wire rack to keep crispy. For the sauce, add honey, ketchup, soy sauce, lemon juice, hot sauce, chili garlic sauce, garlic, and salt to a saucepan. Simmer over medium-low heat for 2–3 minutes until glossy and slightly thickened. Turn heat to low and whisk in the cold butter. Lightly brush the sweet chili garlic glaze over the chicken tenders. For the ranch, whisk everything together and refrigerate for 15–30 minutes. Serve with ranch and enjoy #recipe #chickentenders

🤖 THREEHALVES — THE CENTAUR ROBOT Threehalves is a 7-foot-tall teleoperated robot developed by Satyress. Its design combines a human-like torso and arms with a powerful four-legged chassis, creating a mechanical centaur built for environments that are too dangerous for humans. The idea behind Threehalves is simple: instead of sending a person into extreme heat, unstable terrain, darkness, hazardous industrial environments or disaster zones, a skilled operator can control the robot remotely and perform the work from a safer location. Unlike many humanoid robots, Threehalves is designed around tools and equipment that humans already use. Its modular limbs and quick-connect system allow it to be adapted for different tasks, while its four-legged platform provides stability on difficult terrain. The most unsettling part is probably its appearance. With its enormous size, humanoid body, four mechanical legs and distinctive horned head, Threehalves looks less like a traditional industrial machine and more like something from a science-fiction horror movie. But behind the terrifying design is a serious engineering concept: putting the machine in danger instead of the human. Threehalves is still a developing robotics project, but it represents a strange glimpse into a future where dangerous jobs could be performed remotely — with a human controlling the machine from a distance. And honestly… it might be one of the creepiest robots ever built. 👁️ #threehalves #robot #baal #satyress #horrortok

So the controller who was handling helicopters was also handling landings and departures of planes. This comes after Trump froze the hiring of Air Traffic Controllers and offered them buy outs to leave their jobs earlier this week. He also reportedly fired hundreds of critical staff & allowed Elon to seemingly push the head of the FAA out. Just this past summer, the FAA released a report that it needed 3,000 more air traffic controllers nationally. This morning Trump blamed DEI DEI DEI. But Trump is doubling down on this lie with him now signing a Presidential memorandum ordering competence over DEI. videos.caption: Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Vodka chicken Parmesan sandwich on a garlic knot sandwich roll ✨  I got another 10/10 from my husband and I actually tried a piece and can confirm it was sooo good!  Ingredients Chicken - 1.5 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, thinly sliced - 1 tbsp olive oil - 1 heaping tsp oregano - 1 heaping tsp garlic powder - 1 heaping tsp onion powder - 1 heaping tsp smoked paprika - Salt & pepper, to taste - Avocado oil, for frying - Mozzarella cheese - Pesto, for sandwich Dredge - 1 cup all-purpose flour - 3 eggs, beaten - 1 cup panko breadcrumbs - 1 tbsp parsley, finely chopped - 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, shredded - 1 tbsp garlic powder (1/2tbsp for flour, 1/2 tbsp for panko) - Salt & pepper, to taste Vodka Sauce - 1 tbsp olive oil  - 1 shallot, finely diced - 4 garlic cloves, minced - 3 tbsp tomato paste - 1/4 cup vodka - 1 1/4 cups heavy cream - 2 tbsp unsalted butter - 2/3 cup Parmesan cheese, freshly shredded - 1 heaping tsp oregano - 1 heaping tsp Italian seasoning - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt & pepper, to taste Garlic Knot Sandwich Rolls - 415 g bread flour (3 1/4 cups) - 240 g warm water (1 cup) - 55 g olive oil (1/4 cup) - 38 g granulated sugar (3 tbsp) - 1 tbsp garlic powder - 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast - 1 tsp salt Garlic Butter - 1/4 cup unsalted butter - 1 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped - 3 garlic cloves, grated - 1/2 tsp garlic powder - Salt, to taste Instructions Garlic Knot Rolls - In a bowl, combine warm water, sugar, and yeast. Let bloom 5–10 minutes until foamy. - Add olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and flour. Mix until a dough forms. - Knead 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Place in an oiled bowl, cover, and rise 1–1½ hours or cold-proof overnight until doubled. - Divide dough into equal pieces. Roll into long ropes and tie into loose figure-8 knots, stretching slightly to elongate. - Cover and rise 30–45 minutes. - Brush with egg wash and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 16–20 minutes until golden. - Melt butter and mix with garlic, parsley, garlic powder, and salt. Brush generously over warm rolls. Vodka Sauce - Heat a pan over medium-high heat. Add olive oil, add shallots and cook 2–3 minutes until softened. - Add garlic and cook until fragrant. - Stir in tomato paste and cook 2–3 minutes until slightly darkened and caramelized. - Deglaze with vodka, scraping the pan. Simmer 1–2 minutes until reduced. - Add oregano, Italian seasoning, and red chili flakes. - Lower heat to medium-low and stir in heavy cream. Simmer gently 4–5 minutes. - Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan a little at a time until smooth. - Add butter and mix until glossy. Season with salt and pepper. Chicken - Toss chicken with olive oil, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. - Dredge in flour → egg → panko, pressing to adhere. - Fry in avocado oil over medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Drain on a rack. - Spoon a thin layer of vodka sauce over chicken, top with mozzarella, and broil 2–3 minutes until melted. - Split garlic knot rolls. - Spread pesto on the top bun. - Spoon vodka sauce on the bottom bun. - Add crispy chicken. - Finish with more vodka sauce. - Close, press gently, and serve warm. • • • #recipe #chickenrecipe #dinnerideas #recipeideas #chickenparm

Strawberry Pancakes 🍓✨ For the pancakes: * 2 eggs * 1 cup (240 ml) milk * ½ cup (65 g) all-purpose flour * 2 tbsp cornstarch * 2 tbsp sugar * 2 tbsp melted butter * 1 tsp vanilla extract * A pinch of salt * 1 tsp beetroot powder Whisk everything together until smooth, then strain the batter. Let it rest for about 30 minutes. Lightly grease a non-stick pan and cook very thin pancakes over low heat for about 30–40 seconds per side. Keep the heat low so they stay soft and keep that pretty pink color. Let them cool completely before filling. For the filling: * 1 cup (240 ml) cold heavy whipping cream * 2 tbsp powdered sugar * 1 tsp vanilla extract * Fresh strawberries, thinly sliced Whip the cream until stiff peaks form. Place a pancake smooth-side down, add some whipped cream, arrange the sliced strawberries on top, add a little more whipped cream, then fold in the sides and roll into a neat rectangle. Chill for at least 1 hour before serving. 🍓🤍 #pancakes #strawberries #easyrecipe #homemade #foodie

Soup on Sunday: Marry Me Chicken Soup 💍🍗 Marry Me Chicken is one of my FAVORITE dishes and when I found a soup recipe inspired by it, I asked zero questions. I did find that I wanted to add more broth than the original recipe called for and I also don’t think the cream cheese is 100% necessary. It looked perfectly creamy without it, BUT I wanted to give the original recipe a shot. But do what sounds best to you!! Recipe by: Savor & Nest • ½ cup sun-dried tomatoes (julienne-cut, packed in oil with herbs) • 1 tbsp oil from sun-dried tomato jar • 1 ½ cups chopped yellow onion • 4-6 cloves garlic, minced • 3 tbsp tomato paste • 6-8 cups chicken broth, depending on how thick you want it • 1 cup heavy whipping cream • 4 tsp fresh basil (plus more for garnish) • 2 tsp kosher salt • 1 ½ tsp dried Italian seasoning • 1 tsp garlic powder • ¼ tsp crushed red pepper (or more if you like heat) • 8 oz uncooked medium shell pasta • 3 cups fresh baby spinach, roughly chopped • 2 cups shredded rotisserie chicken • 8 oz cream cheese, cubed (room temperature) • 1 ½ oz Parmesan cheese, finely shredded (plus more for garnish) INSTRUCTIONS:  • Heat 1 tablespoon of sun-dried tomato oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onions and cook for 3-4 minutes until softened, then add and cook garlic until fragrant. • Stir in tomato paste and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the tomato paste deepens in color. • Pour in the chicken broth, cream, basil, salt, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, and crushed red pepper. Bring to a gentle boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Let it simmer for 12 minutes. • Add the pasta, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook for 12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is tender. • Lower the heat to low, then stir in spinach, shredded chicken, cream cheese, and Parmesan. Stir often for 5 minutes until the cheeses melt and the chicken is warmed through. • Ladle into bowls, garnish with extra Parmesan. #soup #marrymechickensoup #easyrecipe #food #souprecipe

Cinnamon rolls… made in 20 minutes, and every bite is the center of the cinnamon Roll In depth recipe with pictures on substack!!! 🛒 Ingredients Dough 1 cup (130g) all purpose flour 1 tsp baking powder 1/4 tsp salt 1 tsp cinnamon 1/3 cup (80ml) milk (or half milk, half heavy cream) 1 tsp vanilla 1 tbsp melted butter Coating 1 tbsp melted butter 3 tbsp sugar 1-2 tsp cinnamon Vanilla Bean Glaze ✨ 4 tbsp powdered sugar 2 tsp heavy cream 1/2 tsp vanilla Vanilla bean or vanilla bean paste 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1️⃣ Preheat oven to 375°F and grease or line your pan 2️⃣ In a bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon 3️⃣ Warm milk slightly, then mix in vanilla and melted butter 4️⃣ Pour wet into dry and mix until a soft dough forms, stop as soon as it comes together, don’t overmix 5️⃣ Lightly flour your surface, roll dough into a log, flatten slightly, and cut into 20 even bites 6️⃣ Toss each piece in melted butter, then coat fully in cinnamon sugar 7️⃣ Place in pan in a single layer with a little space between each, no stacking 8️⃣ Bake 9 to 10 minutes, until lightly golden, don’t overbake 9️⃣ While baking, mix glaze until smooth, adjust thickness if needed 🔟 Let bites cool 1 to 2 minutes, drizzle glaze over the top while warm, and enjoy ⏱ Time & Servings Prep 10 min Cook 10 min Serves 2 to 3 🔥 Pro Tip Mix just until the dough comes together, overmixing is what makes these dense instead of soft and pillowy. School Nights in the Slow Cooker  Part 4 | Crockpot Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo  This is one of those easy dinners that feels like comfort food but is simple enough for a busy school night! Ingredients 1–1½ lbs chicken breast ½ sweet onion, diced ½ cup shredded carrots Chicka Licka Bam Bam Chicken Rub, to taste @Fire & Smoke Society  ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 2 tsp chicken bouillon powder ½ tsp paprika ¼ tsp black pepper 1½ cups chicken broth 2 cups broccoli 1 cup orzo 1 (8 oz) block cheddar cheese, freshly shredded plus more for topping  ½ cup heavy cream Salt, to taste at the end Directions 1. Add the chicken, diced onion, shredded carrots, chicken rub, garlic powder, onion powder, chicken bouillon powder, paprika, black pepper, and chicken broth to your slow cooker. 2. Cover and cook on LOW for 4–5 hours or HIGH for 2–3 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and tender. 3. Remove the chicken, shred or chop it, and return it to the slow cooker. 4. Stir in the orzo, broccoli, heavy cream, and shredded cheddar. Cover and cook on HIGH for about 30 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the orzo is tender. Keep an eye on it toward the end since orzo can absorb liquid quickly. 5. Taste before adding any salt. The chicken bouillon and chicken rub already contain salt, so you may not need much! #easyrecipe #crockpot #slowcooker #dinnerideas #easydinner

Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Aglio e Olio🍝🧄 Ingredients (Serves 2) • 250g spaghetti • 6 garlic cloves, thinly sliced • 60ml extra virgin olive oil • 1 tsp red chilli flakes (adjust to taste) • Handful fresh parsley, finely chopped • Salt • Pasta water, reserved Instructions 1. Cook the pasta:     Bring a large pot of heavily salted water to a boil.     Cook the spaghetti until al dente.     Reserve at least 250ml pasta water before draining. 2. Build the sauce:     Add the olive oil to a large pan over medium heat.     Add the sliced garlic and chilli flakes.     Cook gently until the garlic turns lightly golden.     Do not let it burn. 3. Emulsify:     Add the cooked pasta directly to the pan.     Add a splash of pasta water.     Toss continuously until the oil and water form a silky sauce. 4. Finish:     Remove from the heat.     Stir through the chopped parsley.     Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. 5. Serve:     Plate immediately and finish with extra parsley and chilli flakes if desired. #pastatiktok #aglioeoliopasta #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #pastarecipes

Cheesy BBQ Chicken sliders are a super easy dinner that my family loves! INGREDIENTS 12 count Hawaiian Original Rolls Olive oil  1 lb chicken breast, cut into cubes 1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning  1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese  BBQ sauce  1 cup shredded Colby Jack cheese  6 pieces of bacon, cooked and crumbled  Crispy onions  2 tbsp butter 1/2 tsp each garlic powder and dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS  Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 lb of cubed chicken to the skillet with some olive oil. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning. Stir well and cook until the chicken is fully cooked reaching an internal temperature of 165 degrees F.  Slice Hawaiian Original Rolls in half. Add a layer of shredded mozzarella cheese and top with the cooked chicken. Drizzle some BBQ  sauce over the chicken and top with shredded Colby Jack cheese. Sprinkle on some crumbled bacon and crispy onions. Place the tops of the rolls on the sliders.  Mix together 2 tbsp of melted butter with garlic powder and dried parsley. Brush this over the tops of the sliders. Bake the sliders in the oven at 350 degrees F for 10-15 minutes. Enjoy!  #easyrecipes #dinner #sliderrecipes

Quick and Easy dinner for your next busy night! One Pan Cheesy Parmesan Garlic Chicken & Rice 😮‍💨 INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breast, cut into cubes  2 tbsp butter  1 onion, chopped  1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper 1 tsp each of smoked paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning   1 tbsp minced garlic BWW Parmesan Garlic Sauce  2 cups of chicken broth  1 cup white jasmine rice, rinsed   1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese  2 oz cream cheese 4 pieces of bacon, cooked and crumbled Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS  If you don’t have any bacon leftover from breakfast cook your bacon, drain the grease, and chop it into small pieces. To keep this recipe even easier you could use bacon bits  Cut 1 lb of chicken into small pieces. Add butter to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and spread out evenly in pan. Add the chopped onion and season with salt, pepper, paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning.  Once the chicken is almost cooked add the minced garlic and add 2-3 tbsp of Parmesan garlic sauce to the pan and stir. Add the rinsed rice to the center of the skillet and let toast for a couple of minutes. Add the chicken broth to the skillet and stir well. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover with a lid.  Let cook covered for about 15-20 minutes or until rice is cooked. Add about a cup of shredded cheese and the cream cheese. Stir well.  Top with more cheese and the crumbled bacon. Cover with the lid to let the cheese melt or pop it in the oven under the broiler for just a few minutes.  Top with dried parsley.  Enjoy! Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Breast Ingredients 1. 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 garlic cloves, minced 5. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp salt 8. 1/2 tsp black pepper 9. 1 cup heavy cream 10. 1/2 cup chicken broth 11. 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp garlic powder 13. 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Sear the chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. 4. Remove the chicken and keep warm. 5. Melt the butter in the same pan. 6. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream, stirring well. 8. Add Parmesan cheese and cook until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. 10. Simmer for 3–5 minutes so the flavors combine. 11. Garnish with fresh parsley. 12. Serve with mashed potatoes, pasta, or roasted vegetables. Follow for more delicious recipes!

Meals for Weight-loss:  Mexican Chicken Corn Salad Ingredients:  Chicken * Chicken breast, 800 g * Lime juice, 2 tbsp * Avocado oil, 1 tbsp * Chili powder, 2 tsp * Cumin, 1.5 tsp * Garlic powder, 1 tsp * Paprika, 1 tsp * Salt, 1 tsp * Black pepper, 0.5 tsp Veggies * Cotija cheese, 50 g * Red onion, 1 large, finely diced * Red bell pepper, 1 large, finely diced * Cilantro, 1 handful, chopped * Jalapeños, 3, finely diced * Canned corn, 2 cups total, drained and charred Sauce * Plain 0% Greek yogurt, 1 cup * Lime juice, from 0.5 lime * Hot sauce, 1 tbsp * Tajín, 1 tbsp * Water, 0.5 cup * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste Instructions 1. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized cubes, then add it to a bowl with lime juice, avocado oil, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well and marinate for 15 to 30 minutes. 2. Heat a large pan on medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and fully cooked to 165°F. 3. Drain the canned corn really well and pat it dry with paper towel. In the same pan or a clean hot pan, add the corn in a single layer and let it sit untouched for 2 to 3 minutes, then stir and cook another 2 to 3 minutes until charred in spots. 4. In a bowl, mix Greek yogurt, lime juice, hot sauce, Tajín, water, salt, and black pepper until smooth. 5. In a large bowl, add the charred corn, red onion, red bell pepper, cilantro, jalapeños, and cotija cheese. 6. Pour in the sauce and mix everything until coated. 7. Divide the chicken and street corn salad mixture into 4 servings. Store chilled and eat within 3 to 4 days. Korean Popcorn Chicken 🍿🍗 For all of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store ‼️🫶 The crispiest korean porocrn chicken… sweet, spicy and so simple. You can also make this in the air fryer!!🔥 For the Chicken: -2 lb chicken thighs or breasts, cut into 1 inch cubes -2 eggs -2 tbsp rice vinegar -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp gochugaru (optional) -1/4 cup cornstarch -1/2 cup all-purpose flour -Neutral oil, for frying For the Sauce: -1.5 tbsp gochujang -2 tsp sesame seeds -3 tbsp ketchup -4 garlic cloves, minced -1.5 tbsp honey -3 tbsp butter -1 tbsp rice vinegar -1 tbsp soy sauce -2 tsp sesame oil -1 tsp gochugaru (optional) Garnish: -Sesame seeds -Green onions, sliced Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine chicken with eggs, vinegar, garlic, ginger, & seasonings. Mix well & marinate as long as you wish (1 hour ideal, 1 min works). →For frying: add the cornstarch & flour directly into the same bowl and mix until evenly coated & sticky. →For air frying: do NOT add flour yet. You’ll coat it separately in step 2. 2. For frying: skip this step & go to step 3. For air frying: in a new bowl, mix cornstarch & flour. Remove chicken from marinade then toss in dry ingredients until fully coated. Press lightly so it sticks. 3. For frying: heat neutral oil to 350°F / 175°C. Fry in batches for 7–8 mins until golden and crispy, transfer to a rack. 4. For air frying: oil the basket & spray/brush the chicken with oil. Cook at 375°F for 8 mins, flip, cook for 6–8 mins more until crispy & cooked through. Work in batches. 5. In a pan over medium-low heat, combine gochujang, ketchup, sesame seeds, garlic, honey, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, & optional gochugaru. Bring to a simmer, add butter, stir until melted, remove from heat. 6. Add the chicken directly to the sauce & toss OR in a mixing bowl, combine your desired amount of sauce with the chicken to control how saucy it gets. 7. Serve over jasmine rice, garnish with sesame seeds & green onions. Enjoy :) #recipesoftiktok #chicken #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Sheet Pan Creamy Garlic Cheesy Chicken & Potatoes🧀🍗🍟 A new way to Meal Prep your High Protein Meals for The Week. Oven Sheet Pan recipes are extremely efficient, minimal cleanup, very low effort. This first one is incredibly indulgent and packed with flavour🤤🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Servings (8 Total) 536 Calories | 52g Protein | 44g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Chicken & Seasonings - 800g Raw Chicken Breast, cubed - 800g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 5 Tsp Italian Herbs Seasoning - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4-5 Tsp Paprika - 6 Tsp Olive Oil Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1600g Raw Potatoes, cubed - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs Seasoning - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - Cooking Spray or 3 Tsp Olive Oil Creamy Sauce + Garnish - 400-450ml Regular or Evaporated Milk - 250g Light Garlic & Herb Cream Cheese - 120g Shredded Mozzarella or any Cheese - Fresh Parsley, finely chopped - Grated Parmesan (optional) 👨‍🍳 Instructions • Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Season well then set aside. • Add cubed potatoes and chopped red onion to a large lined oven sheet pan (I used a 41 x 36 x 5 inch sheet pan). Season well with spices listed and cooking spray then bake in a 200C/400F preheated oven dor 20-22 mins. Not need to fully cook. • Once cooked, spread marinated chicken over the potatoes in a single layer, spray cooking spray and place back in the oven for 25 mins until perfectly cooked and juicy. • Once out, add evaporated or regular milk, light cream cheese and a good handful of mozzarella. • The remaining heat from the pan will help melt and thicken the creamy sauce. Mix everything until fully combined, creamy and the cheese melted. • Now garnish and divide into 8 or more servings depending on your calorie needs and ENJOY! . . . . #chicken #mealprep #sheetpandinner #highprotein #healthyeating

One pot chicken fajita rice skillet smothered in queso 🤤 The easiest weeknight dinner and one of those recipes the whole family will love. Save this one for your next easy dinner! One-Pot Chicken Fajita Rice Skillet Recipe  Ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 onion, sliced 3 bell peppers, sliced into strips yellow, red & green 2 chicken breasts, sliced into strips 1 packet fajita seasoning 1 tablespoon garlic 1 can Rotel, undrained 1 cup rice, washed  1 teaspoon tomato bouillon 2 cups chicken broth Queso: 1 can green chiles 1 small can evaporated milk (5 oz) ½ pound white American cheese slices, from the deli Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and bell peppers and cook until softened. Add the sliced chicken and fajita seasoning. Stir to coat everything and cook until the chicken is fully cooked through. Add the garlic and Rotel. Stir to combine. Add the rice, chicken broth, and tomato bouillon. Stir everything together. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and cook for 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed. While the rice cooks, make the queso. Add the evaporated milk, green chiles, and the white American cheese to a small saucepan over low heat. Stir until the cheese is completely melted and the queso is smooth. Fluff the rice, then pour the queso evenly over the top. Serve hot. #OnePotMeals #DinnerIdeas #EasyRecipe #WeeknightDinner #MealIdeas

Raspberry cheesecake donuts ✨ Ingredients  Donuts - 435g bread flour (3 cups + 2 tbsp) - 68g granulated sugar (1/3 cup) - 185g whole milk (3/4 cup) - 60g unsalted butter, softened (4 tbsp) - 7g active dry yeast (2 1/4 tsp) - 2 large eggs - 1 tsp vanilla extract  - 1/2 tsp salt - Canola oil for frying Raspberry jam - 300g raspberries (about 2 cups) - 225g granulated sugar (1 cup + 2 tbsp) - Juice of 1/2 lemon - Cornstarch slurry Cheesecake filling - 5 oz cream cheese, softened  - 250g powdered sugar (2 cups) - 57g unsalted butter, softened (4 tbsp) - 45g heavy cream (3 tbsp) - 2 tsp vanilla extract - 1 dolop of raspberry jam - 1/4 tsp salt  Raspberry sugar  - 15g freeze dried raspberries, blended (about 1 cup) - 120g granulated sugar (1/2 cup) Instructions  - In a large bowl, bloom the yeast with 1 tbsp honey in the warm milk for 5–10 minutes, or until foamy - Add eggs, sugar, vanilla extract and mix until well combined. - Add the flour and salt, then mix until a shaggy consistency  - Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface (or use a stand mixer) and knead for 10–20 minutes, adding 1 tbsp of softened butter at a time until fully incorporated. Continue kneading until the dough is smooth, elastic, and passes the windowpane test. - Transfer dough to a lightly greased bowl, cover, and let rise 1–1½ hours, or until doubled in size. - While the dough rises, make the raspberry jam by cooking the raspberries, sugar, and lemon juice until thick. Add a cornstarch slurry if needed. Let cool. - Beat together the cream cheese, butter, powdered sugar, heavy cream, vanilla, salt, and a dollop of raspberry jam until fluffy. Refrigerate both fillings while the dough rises, then let them sit at room temperature before filling. - Punch down dough and separate into 12 balls (weighing 65g each) - Place the dough balls on a parchment-lined baking tray, leaving space between each. - Cover loosely and let rise for 30–40 minutes, or until puffy. When gently poked, the dough should slowly spring back, leaving a slight indentation. - In a large skillet heat oil to 315–335°F (aim for 330°F) - Fry the donuts, flipping every 30–45 seconds, until evenly golden brown and cooked through (about 2–3 minutes total). - Transfer the donuts to a wire rack to drain for 1–2 minutes. - Mix the freeze-dried raspberry powder with the sugar, then coat the warm donuts. - Poke a hole in each donut, then pipe in the raspberry jam followed by the cheesecake filling. • • • #baking #recipes #recipeideas #bakingideas #donuts

Korean Popcorn Chicken 🍿🍗 This is one of my personal all-time favorite high-protein dinners. Crispy chicken tossed in a Korean sauce that’s sweet, savory and full of flavor. Air fried or oven baked, this is one that will for sure end up in your weekly rotation. If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that help you eat better and spend less. Follow me for more weeknight staples. Ingredients Chicken • 2 lb chicken breast (or thighs), cut into bite-size pieces • 2 eggs • 3 tbsp soy sauce • ¾ tsp salt • ¾ tsp black pepper • 1½ tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp ginger powder Crispy Coating • 1 cup cornstarch • 3 tbsp flour • ¾ tsp baking powder Korean Sauce • ⅓ cup gochujang • 3 tbsp brown sugar • 3 tbsp ketchup • 4 tbsp honey • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 3 tbsp soy sauce • 3 tbsp rice vinegar • 1½ tbsp sesame oil • 1 tbsp butter Garnish • green onions • sesame seeds Instructions 1.	In a large bowl, combine the chicken, eggs, soy sauce, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and ginger powder. Mix until the chicken is fully coated. 2.	Add the cornstarch, flour, and baking powder. Toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 3.	Cook the chicken. Air fryer: Preheat to 400°F. Cook for 8 minutes, flip the chicken, then cook another 4 minutes until crispy. Oven: Bake at 425°F for 15–20 minutes, flipping halfway through. 4.	In a pan over medium heat, combine the gochujang, brown sugar, ketchup, honey, garlic, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil. Let it simmer for 3–4 minutes until thick, then turn off the heat and whisk in the butter. 5.	Add the crispy chicken to a bowl and pour in about ½ cup of the sauce. Toss until fully coated, adding more sauce if needed. 6.	Serve over rice and top with green onions and sesame seeds. #easyrecipe #koreanchicken #popcornchicken #koreanpopcornchicken

CHICKEN KEBAB #food #recipe #chicken #kebab GROUND CHICKEN 50 g red bell pepper, finely diced 50 g green bell pepper, finely diced 15 g fresh parsley, finely chopped 100 g yellow onion (1 onion), finely chopped 4 garlic cloves, finely chopped 7 g salt (1⅙ tsp) 5 g ground cumin (1⅔ tsp) 5 g paprika (1⅔ tsp) 1 g chili flakes 3 g cayenne pepper (1 tsp) 2 g black pepper (⅔ tsp) lemon juice (½ lemon) 45 ml olive oil 750 g ground chicken WRAP wraps vegetables of your choice sauce of your choice Ready all the ingredients. Add the red bell pepper, green bell pepper, fresh parsley, yellow onion, and garlic to a food processor. Blend until you have a vegetable mixture. Transfer the vegetable mixture to a large, deep bowl. Add the salt, ground cumin, paprika, chili flakes, cayenne pepper, black pepper, lemon juice, olive oil, and ground chicken. Knead until combined. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread the chicken mixture evenly over the baking sheet and press it down firmly. Then cut the mixture into straight strips. Use a spoon to press half-moon shapes next to each other. Place the kebab in a preheated oven at 225°C (440°F). Bake for 20–25 minutes. Then switch the oven to the grill setting and grill for 5 minutes, or until the top is nicely golden brown and slightly crispy. Take a wrap and spread with your desired sauce. Fill the wrap with vegetables and pieces of kebab. Fold the wrap until closed. Grill the filled wrap until the wrap is nicely crispy and golden brown.

They make a delicious dessert or Valentine’s day treat! 📌Full printable recipe with tips for different size bowls and alternatives is on my website gimmedelicious.com (link in bio)  Ingredients  ▢ 4 oz bittersweet chocolate ▢ 4 oz butter ▢ 2 large eggs ▢ 1/2 cup sugar ▢ 2 Tablespoons flour ▢ 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ▢ 1/2 teaspoon Instant coffee or espresso powder, optional   Instructions  Preheat oven to 400°F. Generously butter and dust 4 (4 oz) ramekins with cocoa powder or sugar; set aside. In a medium microwave-safe bowl, melt chocolate and butter in 30-second increments. In a separate large bowl, whisk the eggs and sugar until pale and fluffy. Whisk in the melted chocolate along with the flour, vanilla, and instant coffee if desired. Divide batter into ramekins and place them on a baking sheet. Bake 10-12 minutes or until the edges begin to pull away from the ramekins but the center is still jiggly. Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. EASY MEALS FOR 2, EP. 24 🍯 Honey Garlic Chicken Ingredients Chicken * 375g-400g boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp black pepper * ¼ cup cornstarch Sauce * 60g honey (about 3 tbsp) * 2 tbsp soy sauce * 1 tbsp oyster sauce * 1 tbsp rice vinegar * 19g garlic, minced (4–5 large cloves) * 12g green onion whites, finely sliced Cornstarch Slurry * 1 tsp cornstarch * 2 tsp water Garnish * Sesame seeds * Sliced green onion greens Directions 1. Toss the chicken with the salt, garlic powder, pepper, and cornstarch until evenly coated. 2. Heat enough neutral oil to lightly coat the bottom of a pan. Shallow fry the chicken over medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. 3. Reduce to medium heat. If needed, add a little more oil, then sauté the garlic and green onion whites for 30–60 seconds until fragrant. 4. Pour in the honey, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and rice vinegar. Simmer for 1–2 minutes. 5. Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce thickens. 6. Return the chicken to the pan and toss until every piece is well coated. 7. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions greens Serve with steamed rice and enjoy! 🍚 #honeygarlicchicken #chickenrecipe #easyrecipe #cooking #creatorsearchinsights

Save this for an easy weeknight meal you’ll keep coming back to 🌯💛 RECIPE⬇️ Creamy Chicken Mushroom Wraps Servings: 4 wraps Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 20 minutes Ingredients: For the Chicken: * 2 chicken breasts, diced * 1 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp smoked paprika * ½ tsp black pepper * ½ tsp salt For the Mushroom Mixture: * 1 tbsp butter * 1 cup mushrooms, sliced * ½ medium onion, finely chopped For the Secret Sauce: * ¼ cup mayonnaise * 2+ tbsp creamy pasta sauce * 1 tsp sriracha (adjust to taste) Additional Ingredients: * 1 cup spinach, chopped * ¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped * ½ cup shredded cheese (mozzarella, cheddar, or a blend) * 4 large tortillas Instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the diced chicken and season. Cook for 8–10 minutes, or until the chicken is fully cooked and golden brown. Remove from heat and set aside. 2. In the different pan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and chopped onions, and sauté for about 5 minutes, or until softened and golden brown. 3. Add in the mayonnaise, creamy pasta sauce, and sriracha. 4. Return the cooked chicken to the pan with the mushroom mixture. Stir in the spinach and cilantro. Add the shredded cheese and stir until melted and combined. 5. Place a tortilla flat on a clean surface. Spoon a generous amount of the chicken and mushroom filling into the center. Fold in the sides and roll up tightly to form a wrap. 6. Heat a dry skillet over medium heat. Place each wrap seam-side down in the pan and toast for 1–2 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy. #nourished #nourished #homecooking #chickenwrap #mushroomchicken #easydinner #simpledinneridea #yummyeats #proteindinner #CapCut

Recipe Name Shrimp & Sausage Stuffed Cabbage Ingredients 1. 1 large green cabbage 2. 1 lb (450 g) shrimp, peeled and deveined 3. 12 oz (340 g) smoked sausage, sliced 4. 1 medium onion, diced 5. 1 bell pepper, diced 6. 3 garlic cloves, minced 7. 2 tbsp butter 8. 2 tbsp olive oil 9. 1 tsp paprika 10. 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 11. 1/2 tsp black pepper 12. 1/2 tsp salt 13. 2 tbsp chopped parsley 14. 1 tsp lemon juice Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). 2. Cut the cabbage into thick wedges, keeping the core intact. 3. Roast the cabbage wedges for 15 minutes until slightly tender. 4. Heat butter and olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 5. Sauté onion, bell pepper, and garlic until fragrant. 6. Add sliced sausage and cook until browned. 7. Stir in the shrimp, paprika, Cajun seasoning, salt, and pepper, cooking just until the shrimp turn pink. 8. Spoon the shrimp and sausage mixture over each roasted cabbage wedge. 9. Return to the oven for 8–10 minutes to blend the flavors. 10. Finish with lemon juice and chopped parsley before serving hot. Follow our account for more delicious recipes you'll love to make.

Meals for Weight-loss: Ep 8 Honey Garlic Chicken 640 cals, 58g protein, 54 carbs, 12 fat per serving Makes 4 servings You can find all my recipes link in bio!  You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes. 3. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 600 g broccoli florets and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Pour in 2-3 tbsp water, cover for 1 minute, then uncover and season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together for another 1-2 minutes, then set aside. 5. In the same wok, add 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and ¾ cup water. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Now it’s time to enjoy! #healthyrecipes #mealprep #healthyfoodshare #amateurprochef #takeoutrecipes
