Ingredients - 1 loaf French bread or Italian bread - 3 tbsp unsalted butter - 5 cloves garlic, minced - 2 boneless skinless chicken breast  - 1 cup heavy cream - 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese - 1 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese (1/4 for pasta sauce the rest for bread) - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp basil - 1 tsp red chili flakes  - Salt and black pepper to taste - Fresh parsley, chopped (for garnish) Garlic butter - 1 stick unsalted butter, softened  - 2 tbsp parsley, chopped - 1/4 cup Parmesan  - 2 tsp garlic paste - 1 tsp garlic powder - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions - Set to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. - Slice the loaf in half lengthwise. In a small bowl, mix softened butter, garlic paste, parsley, garlic powder, salt, pepper and stir until combined. - Brush evenly over both halves of the bread. Toast in the oven for 5–7 minutes until slightly golden. (Optional) - In a saucepan over medium high hear sear chicken breast on both sides for 5-8 minutes or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove from pan. - In the same pan, add butter, and minced garlic. Cook until fragrant about 1-2 minutes. Add heavy cream and Stir until smooth. - Add mozzarella, Parmesan cheese and stir until melted and creamy. - Season with garlic powder, oregano, basil, red pepper chili flakes, salt and pepper. - Spoon the Alfredo sauce evenly over each bread half. Sprinkle extra mozzarella on top. Add sliced chicken and more Alfredo sauce. - Return to the oven for 15-25 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly. - Garnish with chopped parsley. - Slice and serve warm. • • • #Recipe #recipeideas #garlicbread #DinnerIdeas

videos.caption: Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

Crockpot Marry Me Meatballs are an easy and delicious dinner!  INGREDIENTS 1 1/2 lbs frozen meatballs  15 oz jar Alfredo sauce 1/2 tsp pepper, oregano, thyme 1 tsp each onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes 1/3 cup chopped sun dried tomatoes 1/3 cup Parmesan cheese 1/2 cup milk Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS Add frozen meatballs to a crockpot with one jar of Alfredo sauce. Season with pepper, oregano, thyme, onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and red pepper flakes.  Add chopped sun dried tomatoes, Parmesan cheese and milk. Stir everything well.   Cook on low for 4 hours. Top meatballs with more Parmesan cheese and dried parsley.  *If the oil from the sun dried tomatoes causes any separation stir in another splash of milk before serving!  Serve over mashed potatoes or rice. Enjoy!  #crockpot #meatballs #easyrecipes #easydinners

¡Tensión Extrema! Abuela Cae en la Guarida del Tigre y Su Hija Salta para Salvarla en un Zoológico de Pesadilla ​ ​¡Quedó a centímetros de las garras! Lo que debía ser un día de paseo familiar se convirtió en una pesadilla de alto riesgo. Una mujer de la tercera edad experimentó el pánico absoluto al desplomarse la baranda de seguridad, cayendo en picada directamente al recinto de un imponente tigre adulto. El estruendo de la caída y los gritos de horror de los visitantes inundaron el lugar. En un acto de valentía desesperada, su hija no lo dudó: saltó al foso para interponerse entre su madre y el depredador. El enorme felino, una mole de músculo y dientes, las observaba a escasos metros. Contra todo pronóstico, y en un desenlace milagroso, ambas salieron ¡totalmente ilesas! Spicy Brazilian-style coconut chicken with tender chicken thighs, creamy coconut sauce, and a hint of lime and cilantro. Comfort food with a tropical twist🥥 I hope you’ll give it a try ❤️ Ingredients (2-3 person) For the Spicy Coconut Chicken •	14 oz/400 g chicken thighs, boneless  •	Salt and freshly cracked black pepper •	Juice of ½ lime •	1 tsp paprika •	chili flakes (adjust to taste) •	0,5 tsp cayenne (adjust to taste) •	olive oil For the Sauce •	1 small onion, chopped •	3 garlic cloves, minced •	1 red bell pepper, sliced •	2 medium sized tomato  chopped  •	1 tbsp tomato paste •	1 can coconut milk / 400 ml / 13.5 oz •	½ tsp turmeric •	1 tsp paprika or smoked paprika for a more smookey flavor  •	0,5 tsp cumin  To Serve •	White or coconut rice •	Lime wedges for garnish •	fresh cilantro, chopped  •	Optional: fresh red chili, for extra heat Instructions 1.	Season the chicken: Mix chicken with lime juice, salt, pepper, paprika, chili flakes, cayenne (optional), and olive oil. Let sit 10-15 min. 2.	Sear the chicken: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken thighs and sear 6-8 min per side until golden. Remove and set aside. 3.	Build the sauce: In the same pan, sauté onion until soft (3-4 min). Add garlic and cook 30 sec. Stir in bell pepper, tomato, tomato paste, and spices, cooking 2-3 min until fragrant. 4.	Add coconut milk: Pour in the full can, stir, and bring to a gentle simmer. Cook a few min until slightly thickened. 5.	Finish the chicken: Return chicken to pan. Simmer 5-10 min or until fully cooked and sauce is creamy. Stir in cilantro. Taste and adjust seasoning or spice. 6.	Serve: Plate chicken with sauce over a generous portion of rice. Garnish with extra cilantro and lime wedges. Recipe Name Loaded Beef Nacho Casserole Ingredients 1. 1 large bag (13–15 oz) tortilla chips 2. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 3. 1 small onion, finely diced 4. 2 cloves garlic, minced 5. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 6. 1/3 cup water 7. 2 cups shredded Mexican cheese blend 8. 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese 9. 1 cup diced tomatoes 10. 1/3 cup diced pickled jalapeños 11. 1/2 cup salsa 12. 1/2 cup sour cream (for serving) 13. 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro 14. 1 tbsp olive oil 15. 1/2 tsp salt 16. 1/2 tsp black pepper Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the onion until soft. 3. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. 4. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, then drain any excess grease. 5. Stir in the taco seasoning, water, salt, and black pepper. Simmer for 3–5 minutes until thickened. 6. Spread half of the tortilla chips in the baking dish. 7. Top with half of the seasoned beef, half of the salsa, and half of both cheeses. 8. Repeat with the remaining chips, beef, salsa, and cheese. 9. Bake for 12–15 minutes, or until the cheese is fully melted and bubbly. 10. Remove from the oven and immediately top with diced tomatoes and jalapeños. 11. Garnish with chopped cilantro. 12. Serve hot with sour cream, guacamole, or extra salsa if desired. The coziest creamy chicken gnocchi soup 🤎🍂 perfect for a chilly fall night! Save this one for your next cozy dinner.   Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio! 🕯️ Creamy chicken gnocchi soup  Ingredients: 	⁃	2 chicken breast 	⁃	3 carrots, diced 	⁃	2 celery stalks, diced  	⁃	1/2 yellow onion, diced  	⁃	4 garlic cloves 	⁃	2 tbsp all purpose flour 	⁃	3 cups chicken broth 	⁃	3 cups half and half 	⁃	1 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	1 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	1/4 tsp paprika 	⁃	1/2 tsp red chili flakes 	⁃	1/2 tsp thyme 	⁃	1/2 tsp black pepper 	⁃	1 tbsp chicken bullion 	⁃	Parmesan rind 	⁃	16 oz gnocchi 	⁃	1 1/2 cup spinach 	⁃	1 cup Parmesan Instructions: Coat the chicken breasts with olive oil, then season generously with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, black pepper, and salt. Heat about 1 teaspoon of olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken for 6–8 minutes per side, or until fully cooked. Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside to rest. While the chicken cooks, dice the onion, celery, and carrots, and mince the garlic. Add the carrots, celery, and onion to the same pot. Cook until the onion becomes translucent, then add the minced garlic and cook for another minute. Stir in the flour and cook briefly. Slowly add the chicken broth and half-and-half, stirring to combine. Add the onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, red pepper flakes, thyme, and chicken bouillon. Stir well, then add the Parmesan rind. Cover the pot and reduce the heat to low-medium. Simmer for 20–25 minutes, or until the soup has thickened and the vegetables are tender. Remove the Parmesan rind. Dice the cooked chicken and add it to the soup along with the gnocchi, spinach, and grated Parmesan. Stir and cook for another 5 minutes, or until the gnocchi is tender and the spinach has wilted. Ladle into bowls and finish with extra grated Parmesan and a sprinkle of red pepper flakes. Enjoy! 🤎 #soup #soupseason #fallrecipes #autumn #fallvibes

The Secret Behind Morocco's Success 🇲🇦 Morocco went from 79th in the FIFA rankings to another World Cup quarter-final in just over 15 years. So how did they pull it off? Back in 2009, Morocco decided to rebuild football from the ground up. They invested millions into a new national football center, scouted more than 15,000 kids across the country, and selected just 57 to join their academy. Almost all of them became professionals, with players like Youssef En-Nesyri and Azzedine Ounahi making it to Europe. At the same time, Morocco also built a huge scouting network to convince players with Moroccan roots, like Achraf Hakimi, Brahim Díaz and, more recently, Ayyoub Bouaddi, to represent the national team. And they haven't stopped. Morocco is building the Grand Stade Hassan II stadium for the 2030 World Cup and continues to invest millions into football across the country. This is dinner on easy mode! 🍲 Stick of Butter Chicken and Rice will be your best friend in the kitchen when you don't feel like spending hours over the stovetop! Continue reading or click the link in the @allrecipes bio for the full recipe. 🔗 Ingredients: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-ounces) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed beef consomme 8 ounces baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan cheese, divided 1 stick butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt 3/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon paprika 1 tablespoon chopped parsley (optional) Directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Stir rice, French onion soup, beef consomme, and portobello mushrooms together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with 3/4 cup of the cheese and add butter pieces on top. Season chicken evenly with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika and place on top of cheese and butter. Top with remaining cheese and cover dish with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake until top is golden brown, liquid has been absorbed into the rice, and chicken is cooked through, about 20 more minutes.  Sprinkle with fresh parsley if desired. Inspiration: @Melissajorealrecipes  🧑‍🍳: @NicoleMcLaughlin  #easydinners #dinnerideas #butter #chicken #chickenandrice

😮‍💨 263 Cal Chicken Caesar Salad Chalupas 📍 My high protein chalupa series has been super viral and I think I might’ve the best one yet! ✅ Macros for each Chalupa: 263 Cals, 15g Carbs, 8g Fat, 36g Protein ✅ Macros (32g) Caesar Dressing: 29 Cals, 0.5g Carbs, 1.75g Fat, 3g Protein ✳️ 29 Cal Caesar Dressing:  227g Plain Non Fat Greek yogurt Juice from ½ Fresh Lemon 14g Olive Oil 30g Worcestershire sauce 10g Dijon Mustard 24g Grated parmesan cheese 3 garlic cloves, minced 1/4 teaspoon Kosher salt Water to desired consistency ✳️ Caesar Salad: 300g Romaine 1/6th Batch Caesar Dressing ✳️ Ingredients for Chicken Caesar Dip: 16oz Chicken Breast 1 ½ tsp Garlic Powder 1 tsp Onion Powder 1 tsp Salt ½ tsp Black Pepper ½ tsp Paprika ½ tsp Dried Parsley 1/6th Batch Caesar Dressing ✳️ Ingredients for 1 Chalupa: 1 Josephs Pita 4g Parmesan 12g Part Skim Mozzarella 1/4th Batch of Chicken Caesar Dip Cooking Spray (added 1g fat to macro per chalupa) ❇️ Directions: 1️⃣ Take your chicken breast and pat dry with a paper towel. Then flatten. I just use my fist lol. 2️⃣ Then season both sides with seasoning mix recipe above. Air fry on 400 degrees F for 9-10 minutes. 3️⃣ While that’s cooking, make your caesar dressing by adding all your ingredients into a bowl and mixing. 4️⃣ Now chop up your chicken breast once done and add to a bowl. Combine with the buffalo caesar dressing 1/6th caesar dressing. 5️⃣ Chop up 300g romaine and add 1/6th caesar dressing to it. Can add more but we don’t want the romaine to be soggy. 6️⃣ Now put together your chalupas. Lay one pita down then add to on side 6g mozzarella, 2g parmesan, 1/4th of your chicken caesar dip, 2g parmesan, 6g mozzarella. 7️⃣ Fold your chalupa tightly. Spray both sides with cooking spray and add to air fryer on 400 degrees F for 4 minutes. I added some ramekins on top of each one to make sure they stayed closed while in the air fryer. 8️⃣ Once done, open them up, add your caesar salad and enjoy! #caesarsalad #chalupa #airfryer #highproteinmeals#mealprep

Cowboy Butter Chicken Alfredo🤠 My daughter said it is her favorite meal I've made 🥹 Ingredients: Large chicken breast, halved Kinder’s cowboy butter  Paprika seasoning Sazon seasoning Malfadine pasta, 8 oz  Rao’s alfredo sauce, 15 oz 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp butter 1/4 cup bone broth Parmesan, for topping  Basil or parsley, for topping  Instructions: Marinate chicken with cowboy butter seasoning, paprika, sazon & 1 tbsp olive oil. Boil pasta almost al dente, drain & reserve some pasta water.  Bring skillet to medium high heat & add butter with a tbsp of olive oil. Reduce heat to medium, add chicken & cook for 5 minutes. Flip chicken, splash in some bone broth to deglaze & continue cooking for another 4-5 minutes. Remove chicken & set to the side to rest.  Reduce heat to low & add remaining bone broth. Stir in alfredo sauce with a splash of pasta water. Simmer for 3-5 minutes toss in pasta. Top with sliced chicken, grated parm & basil. #alfredo #pasta #dinnerideas #recipes #easyrecipe

🌿 5-Minute Dump & Bake Chicken Pesto A ridiculously easy one-pan dinner that tastes fancy but takes almost no effort. If you’ve got 5 minutes, a jar of pesto, and some chicken, dinner is basically done. This dump-and-bake pesto chicken turns juicy, cheesy, and flavorful with almost zero prep—just season, spread, and bake. 🍗 Ingredients * 4 chicken breasts * Salt & pepper * Garlic powder * Oregano * 1 jar pesto * 6–8 slices mozzarella cheese Optional toppings (highly recommended) * Fresh tomato slices * Fresh basil * Balsamic glaze ⸻ 👩‍🍳 Instructions 1️⃣ Prep (takes about 5 minutes) Place the chicken breasts in a baking dish or sheet pan. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and oregano. 2️⃣ Dump the pesto Spread a spoonful of pesto over each chicken breast, then dump the rest of the jar around the chicken so everything bakes in that garlicky goodness. 3️⃣ Bake Bake at 400°F for about 30 minutes. Cooking time may vary depending on the thickness of the chicken. Chicken is ready when it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. 4️⃣ Add the cheese Top each chicken breast with sliced mozzarella. 5️⃣ Melt & finish Return to the oven and bake (or broil) for 10–15 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly. ✨ Optional Finishing Touch Top with fresh tomato slices, fresh basil, and a drizzle of balsamic glaze for a caprese-style upgrade.

Day 31 of sharing easy dinner recipes! 🍽️ This one is easy, delicious, and perfect for a busy weeknight dinner!  Crockpot Marry Me Chicken Sandwiches INGREDIENTS 1 lb chicken breast  1/2 tsp each salt, pepper, oregano, thyme 1 tsp each onion powder and garlic powder 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes 1 tbsp minced garlic 1/3 cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped  1/2 cup of chicken broth  8 slices of bacon  1 block of cream cheese 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese Brioche buns  INSTRUCTIONS  Spray a crockpot with cooking spray and add the chicken. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, onion powder, garlic powder, and red pepper flakes. Next, add the minced garlic, chopped sun dried tomatoes, and chicken broth.  Be sure to stir the sun dried tomatoes and garlic around. You want the sun dried tomatoes to be down in the chicken broth, so they don’t burn.  Cook on low for 4-6 hours. Once the chicken is fully cooked shred the chicken, add a block of cream cheese, and shredded mozzarella cheese. Let this keep cooking on low until the cream cheese is melted and stir everything together well.  Cook bacon while cream cheese is melting. Once bacon is cooked build sandwiches on toasted buns and top with the crispy bacon. Enjoy!  #easyrecipes #dinnerideas #crockpot

I think everyone should have a simple roast chicken recipe they can turn to in a pinch, and this is my favorite! If you’re someone who loves super crunchy skin, this one might not be for you, but it results in the most tender, juicy, flavorful chicken- I’m sure y’all will love it. Full recipe with measurements below!  Spatchcock Roast Chicken with Herb Butter - 3-4lb whole chicken, spatchcocked  - Salt and pepper - 1 lb baby potatoes, halved  - 3 parsnips, peeled and chopped  - 2 small shallots, quartered  - 3 Tbsp olive oil  For the herb compound butter  - 1 stick salted butter  - 1 Tbsp chopped fresh parsley  - 1 tsp chopped fresh thyme  - 2-3 garlic cloves, minced or grated  - Black pepper  Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Arrange potatoes, parsnips and shallots in the bottom of a cast iron skillet, roasting pan or baking dish. Coat with olive oil, salt and pepper and then place about 1/3 of the compound butter over the vegetables in little dollops.  Place the spatchcocked chicken on top of the vegetables, and smear the remaining butter on top. Roast at 450 for about 12-15 minutes, then turn the oven down to 375 and continue to roast until the chicken reaches 165 degrees internally, about 35-40 minutes.  Take the chicken out and let it rest under foil, then return the vegetables to the hot oven for another 10-15 minutes or until browned.  Carve the chicken and serve!  #easydinner #weeknightdinner #roastchicken #chickenrecipe #cookwithme #easyrecipe #dinneridea

BUN BO HUE aka my favorite food EVER 🥢 #bunbohue #vietnamesefood #noodles #easyrecipe #asmr  Bun Bo Hue Broth - Flank steak - Parboiled beef bones - Lemongrass - Pineapple - Ginger - Daikon - Shallot - Yellow onion - Water - Salt - Chicken bouillon - Mushroom bouillon - Fish sauce - Shrimp paste - Saté Parboil the flank steak and beef bones for 5–10 minutes, then rinse well. Add to a large stock pot with slightly smashed lemongrass, pineapple, ginger, daikon, shallot, onion, and a few spoonfuls of salt. Cover with water, bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 1 hour, continuously skimming the scum from the top. Remove the flank steak and set aside to cool, then add the saté and simmer the broth for another 5 hours. Remove the onion, shallot, and ginger (I keep the daikon for my bowls) and season with chicken bouillon, mushroom bouillon, fish sauce, and shrimp paste. Taste and adjust to your preference. Saté - Shallot - Garlic - Lemongrass - Avocado oil - BBH seasoning - Red pepper flakes - Sugar - Shrimp paste - Fish sauce Sauté finely minced shallot, garlic, and lemongrass in avocado oil for about 5 minutes, until slightly golden and fragrant. Add a packet of BBH seasoning and red pepper flakes and sauté for another 2 minutes. Add half to the broth and reserve the other half for garnish. To the reserved saté, add a small ladle of broth, sugar, shrimp paste, and fish sauce, then sauté for another couple minutes. Bowl - Thick rice vermicelli - Cabbage - Bean sprouts - Sliced flank steak - Yellow onion - Green onion - Cilantro - Lime - Saté I like to prep all my toppings ahead of time and store them in glass containers for easy assembly throughout the week. Rinse and dry the cabbage and bean sprouts well, then store in a paper towel-lined container. Keep the sliced flank steak separate. For the noodles, boil for 10–15 minutes depending on thickness, then turn off the heat, cover, and let sit for another 10–15 minutes. Strain and rinse very well to remove excess starch, then let dry for about 15 minutes before assembling.

Loaded Italian Deli Meat Stromboli Ingredients 1. Pizza Dough – 1 lb 2. Pepperoni – 6 oz, thinly sliced 3. Deli Ham – 6 oz, thinly sliced 4. Salami – 6 oz, thinly sliced 5. Provolone Cheese – 6 oz, sliced 6. Mozzarella Cheese – 2 cups, shredded 7. Parmesan Cheese – 1/2 cup, finely grated 8. Pizza Sauce – 1 1/2 cups 9. Garlic – 3 cloves, minced 10. Unsalted Butter – 3 tbsp, melted 11. Italian Seasoning – 2 tsp 12. Dried Oregano – 1 tsp 13. Red Pepper Flakes – 1/2 tsp 14. Salt – 1/2 tsp 15. Black Pepper – 1/2 tsp 16. Fresh Parsley – 2 tbsp, finely chopped 17. Egg – 1 large, beaten 18. Olive Oil – 1 tbsp Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Lightly brush the parchment with the olive oil. 2. In a small bowl, combine the melted butter, minced garlic, Italian seasoning, oregano, red pepper flakes, salt, black pepper, and 1 tablespoon of the fresh parsley. Set the garlic-herb butter aside. 3. Lightly flour a work surface and roll the pizza dough into a large rectangle approximately 12 by 18 inches, keeping the thickness even from edge to edge. 4. Brush a thin layer of the garlic-herb butter over the dough, leaving about a 1-inch border around all sides so the filling stays contained while rolling. 5. Spread 1 cup of pizza sauce over the dough, keeping the sauce inside the border. Sprinkle 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and 1/4 cup of Parmesan evenly over the sauce. 6. Layer the sliced ham, salami, and pepperoni evenly over the cheese. Arrange the meats in overlapping layers so every slice of the finished stromboli contains a generous amount of filling. 7. Add the sliced provolone over the deli meats, then sprinkle the remaining mozzarella and Parmesan over the top. 8. Starting from one long edge, roll the dough tightly over the filling, continuing to roll until you reach the opposite edge. Pinch the seam firmly closed and tuck both ends underneath. 9. Carefully transfer the stromboli seam-side down onto the prepared baking sheet. Brush the entire surface with the beaten egg for a glossy golden crust. 10. Use a sharp knife to cut 5 to 7 shallow diagonal slits across the top of the dough. These vents allow steam to escape while giving the finished stromboli its classic bakery-style appearance. 11. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, rotating the baking sheet halfway through, until the crust is puffed, deeply golden, and crisp and the cheese inside is completely melted. 12. Remove the stromboli from the oven and immediately brush the hot crust with the remaining garlic-herb butter. Sprinkle the remaining fresh parsley over the top. 13. Let the stromboli rest for 10 to 15 minutes before slicing so the melted cheese and meat filling can settle instead of spilling out when cut. 14. Slice into thick pieces and serve warm with the remaining 1/2 cup of pizza sauce heated for dipping. Serve with a simple Italian salad, roasted vegetables, or crispy potato wedges. Serves: 4–6 Ingredients * 2 lbs chicken (thin-cut breasts, regular breasts, diced chicken, or boneless skinless thighs) * 1 (7.5 oz) tub Garden Vegetable Cream Cheese * ½ cup jalapeño jelly * ½ cup chicken broth * 3 tbsp ranch seasoning * Shredded mozzarella or pepper jack cheese Garnish with bacon crumbles or fresh parsley! Chicken Seasoning * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp smoked paprika * ½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. 2. Spray a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray. 3. Place the chicken in the baking dish 4. Season the chicken with the garlic powder, smoked paprika, and black pepper. 5. In a bowl, whisk together:     * Softened Garden Vegetable Cream Cheese     * Jalapeño jelly     * Chicken broth     * Ranch seasoning 6. Pour the sauce evenly over the chicken. 7. Cover tightly with foil and bake according to the times below. 8. Remove from oven the last 5-10 minutes. take off foil, and top with shredded cheese. Place back in oven to melt cheese.  Remove and let sit for another 5-10 minutes to let the sauce thicken slightly. 9. Chicken is done when the thickest piece reaches 165°F. Spoon the sauce over the chicken before serving. Cook Times at 400°F * Thin-cut chicken breasts: 20–25 minutes * Diced chicken (1-inch cubes): 20–25 minutes * Regular chicken breasts (about 1 inch thick): 28–35 minutes * Large/thick chicken breasts (1½–2 inches): 35–45 minutes * Boneless skinless chicken thighs: 30–40 minutes Serve With * Mashed potatoes * White rice * Buttered egg noodles * Roasted broccoli * Green beans * Side salad #fyp #recipes #dinner

This One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi is creamy, cheesy, packed with flavor, and SO easy 😍 Everything cooks in one pan, including the gnocchi, so you get the creamiest sauce with barely any cleanup. Save this one for your next easy weeknight dinner! One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Add spinach and stir until wilted. #marrymechicken #onepotmeal #easydinner #dinnerrecipe #weeknightdinner

Arsenio’s Chicken Alfredo Mac N Cheese 👑🧀🍗 Chicken: 1 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning 1 tbsp black pepper 2 tsp salt Cube your chicken, season it, then cook it halfway on the stove before finishing it in the oven. Roux: ½ cup butter (113g) ½ cup flour (60g) 3 garlic cloves 1 chicken bouillon cube, grated Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp smoked paprika Melt the butter, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Whisk in the flour and cook for 60–90 seconds. Add the grated chicken bouillon cube, then slowly add your milk and cream while whisking until it thickens. Sauce: 3 cups whole milk (720g) 1 cup heavy cream (240g) 3–4 cups shredded cheese (340–450g) — fontina, mozzarella, cheddar Take it off the heat and add your cheese 1 cup at a time until smooth. Pasta: 2 packs Barilla pasta (340g each) Boil the pasta just under al dente, drain and mix it into your cheese sauce. Add the chicken and mix everything together. Put it into a baking dish and cover the top with extra cheese… measure that with your eyes 😂 Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes, then broil on high for 3 minutes. Plate it up and finish with freshly grated Parmesan. 🧀

Recipe Name French Onion Meatloaf with Melted Mozzarella Ingredients 1. 2 lbs (900 g) ground beef 2. 1 cup breadcrumbs 3. 2 large eggs 4. 1 small onion, finely diced 5. 2 large onions, thinly sliced 6. 3 garlic cloves, minced 7. 1/3 cup milk 8. 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 9. 2 tbsp ketchup 10. 1 tsp Dijon mustard 11. 1 tsp salt 12. 1 tsp black pepper 13. 1 tsp garlic powder 14. 1 tsp dried thyme 15. 2 tbsp butter 16. 1 tbsp olive oil 17. 1 cup beef broth 18. 1 tbsp all-purpose flour 19. 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese 20. 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly grease a loaf pan or baking dish. 2. Heat the butter and olive oil in a skillet. Add the sliced onions and cook over medium-low heat for 20–25 minutes until deeply caramelized. 3. Stir in the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Sprinkle in the flour, then add the beef broth and simmer until slightly thickened. Remove from the heat. 4. In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, diced onion, milk, Worcestershire sauce, ketchup, Dijon mustard, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and thyme. 5. Mix gently until just combined, then shape into a loaf and place in the prepared pan. 6. Bake for 40 minutes. 7. Remove the meatloaf from the oven and spoon the caramelized onion mixture evenly over the top. 8. Sprinkle the mozzarella cheese generously over the onions. 9. Return the meatloaf to the oven and bake for another 15–20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted, bubbly, and lightly golden. 10. Let the meatloaf rest for 10 minutes before slicing. 11. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley for extra flavor and color. 12. Serve hot with creamy mashed potatoes and your favorite vegetables. Follow for more delicious and easy recipes!

Me llevo recuerdos y momentos inolvidables vividos. Me voy con la tranquilidad y el orgullo de haberles regalado, juntos con mis compañeros, momentos soñados. Fue una locura haberlo vivido con ustedes. ¡Los quiero! Gracias Dios por hacerme argentino. ¡Vamos Argentina! *Estas palabras las escribí el 21 de julio, dos días después de la final. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Fold in cooked noodles, chicken, and pepperoncini peppers until evenly coated. Spread mixture into the prepared baking dish; sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese. Honey bbq chicken sliders ✨🍔 Ingredients  Chicken  - 1lb chicken breast, cut in half to create smaller pieces  - 1 1/2 cups buttermilk  - 1 egg - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1/4 cup pickle juice  - 1 1/2 cup all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp salt - 1 tsp black pepper  - 1/2 tsp chicken seasoning  - 1/2 tsp msg (optional) - Oil for frying  Dredge mixture  - 1 cup all purpose flour - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder  - 1 tsp chili powder  - 1 tsp cayenne powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp salt - 1/2 tsp pepper  - 1/2 tsp chicken seasoning  Honey bbq sauce - 1 tbsp unsalted butter  - 1/3 cup bbq sauce  - 1/4 cup honey - 1 tbsp hot sauce  - 1 tbsp ketchup - 1 tsp garlic powder  - 1/2 tsp brown sugar  - 1/8 tsp salt  Instructions: - In a bowl, combine chicken pieces, buttermilk, seasonings, pickle juice and hot sauce. Let sit for 3 hours (or overnight in the fridge for best results). - In another bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, cayenne, salt, and pepper. - Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). - Remove chicken from marinade, letting excess drip off. Dredge in seasoned flour mixture, pressing to coat well. - Fry in batches 4–6 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Drain on a wire rack or paper towels.  - In a small saucepan combine honey, butter, brown sugar, ketchup, hot sauce, garlic powder and bbq sauce. Mix until well combined. Let it simmer for 3-4 minutes then remove from heat - Brush chicken with honey bbq sauce on both sides - Slice buns horizontally and brush with butter, place into a pan on medium high heat and toast until slightly golden brown.  - Mix melted butter, parsley and garlic powder. videos.caption: They always ask why I didn’t make more | full recipe ⬇️ Smoked to perfection with @harmosgrill flavored pellets Serves: 6–8  Total Time: ~2–3 hours (including marinade) Ingredients Chicken 3–4 lbs bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs (non-negotiable) 3–4 tbsp spicy brown mustard 2 tbsp Cuso’s Hot Honey Seasoning 2 tbsp Cuso’s Roasted Garlic & Onion Seasoning Grill / Smoke Harmos wood pellets: Spanish Barbecue Pirate & Turkish Barbecue Traveler Jalapeño Green Sauce 2–3 jalapeños (adjust for heat) 1 cup fresh cilantro 2–3 garlic cloves ½ cup Greek yogurt 2–3 tbsp olive oil Salt, to taste Black pepper, to taste Instructions 1. Marinate the Chicken Add chicken thighs to a large bowl. Coat fully with spicy brown mustard. Season generously with Cuso’s Hot Honey + Roasted Garlic & Onion seasoning. Mix until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least a few hours (overnight preferred). 2. Preheat the Grill Preheat your pellet grill to 350°F. Load with Harmos pellets (Spanish Barbecue Pirate + Turkish Barbecue Traveler) for deep smoky flavor with paprika, garlic, rosemary, and spice notes. 3. Make the Jalapeño Green Sauce Add jalapeños, cilantro, garlic, Greek yogurt, olive oil, salt, and pepper to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning or heat. Chill until ready to serve. 4. Smoke the Chicken Place chicken directly on the grill grates. Cook for about 1 hour, until internal temp reaches 160°F. 5. Crank the Heat Increase grill temp to 500°F. Cook until chicken hits 180°F internal and skin gets crispy with great color. 6. Serve Remove from grill and rest a few minutes. Serve with the jalapeño green sauce on the side or drizzled over top. #HarmosGrill  #HarmosWoodPellets  #HarmosFlavoredPellets

Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. ✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 🕒 Total Time: ~35 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #DinnerAtRileys #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

Medicube... what is really going on? Medicube Sudan Red dye scandal. On 24th July 2026, Hong Kong Customs issued a warning to consumers to stop using Medicube's PDRN Pink Collagen Capsule Cream after its government laboratory detected Sudan Red, a banned carcinogenic industrial dye. Medicube has responded by releasing an independent South Korean lab (Intertek) report showing that Sudan Red was 'Not Detected’ The investigation is still ongoing and we do not have all of the information to make definitive conclusions yet. This is not the first time Medicube have been under question due to possible Sudan Red contamination. In late 2025, there was a massive recall of certain red-tinted skincare products in China and Taiwan due to Sudan Red dye contamination traced back to raw material suppliers. Medicube denied being affected by this however they introduced a new formulation in March 2026 for their PDRN pink collagen capsule cream. As skincare consumers, we often assume that products on the shelves are safe. Cases like this are a reminder of why independent third-party testing plays such a vital role in protecting consumer safety. @oneeyebeauty_official 's website has a useful guide for spotting fake products online

Recipe Name Caramel Cream Rice Krispie Treats Ingredients 1. 6 cups crispy rice cereal 2. 4 cups mini marshmallows 3. 4 tbsp unsalted butter 4. 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter 5. 1/2 cup caramel sauce 6. 1 cup white chocolate chips 7. 4 oz cream cheese, softened 8. 1/2 cup powdered sugar 9. 1 tsp vanilla extract 10. 1 cup heavy whipping cream 11. 1/4 cup caramel sauce, for drizzling 12. 1/2 cup crispy rice cereal, for topping Recipe 1. Line a 9×13-inch baking dish with parchment paper and lightly grease it. 2. Melt the butter in a large saucepan over low heat. 3. Add the mini marshmallows and stir continuously until completely melted and smooth. 4. Stir in the peanut butter until fully incorporated. 5. Remove the mixture from the heat and gently fold in the crispy rice cereal. 6. Press half of the cereal mixture firmly into the prepared dish to create an even base. 7. Melt the white chocolate chips gently in the microwave in short intervals, stirring between each interval. 8. Beat the softened cream cheese, powdered sugar, and vanilla until smooth. 9. Whip the heavy cream until soft peaks form, then gently fold it into the cream cheese mixture. 10. Spread the cream mixture evenly over the first cereal layer. 11. Refrigerate for 15–20 minutes to help the creamy layer firm up. 12. Gently press the remaining cereal mixture over the cream layer without crushing it. 13. Warm the caramel sauce slightly and drizzle it generously over the top. 14. Sprinkle additional crispy rice cereal over the caramel. 15. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour until firm enough to slice. 16. Lift the dessert from the pan using the parchment paper and cut into neat squares. 17. Drizzle each piece with extra caramel before serving for an extra rich finish. Follow this account for more irresistible no-fuss desserts and recipes you will want to make again.

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

mix well -marinade for at least 30 min up to overnight  -air fry at 400F for 20 min or bake at 400F for 30 min until internal temp is 165F -rest for 10 min; cut into bite-sized pieces  Cilantro Lime Rice 🍚 Ingredients: -1 1/2 cups uncooked white rice, rinsed,rinse -2 1/2 cups chicken bone broth  -dried bay leaf -3 limes  -1/2 cup chopped cilantro  -1 tsp olive oil -1/4 tsp lime zest  -salt to taste  Instructions: -add rice to rice cooker with broth and bay leaf -cook until fluffy; transfer to bowl -add oil, cilantro, lime zest and juice, and salt; mix well  Seasoned Black Beans 🫘 Ingredients: -1 cup eduncooked black beans, rinsed -3 cups water  -1 tbs tomato paste -1/2 tsp onion powder  -1/2 tsp garlic powder -1/2 tsp smoked paprika  -1/2 tsp ground cumin  -1/2 tsp dried oregano  -1/2 tsp salt -1/2 tsp black pepper -dried bay leaf  Instructions: -add all ingredients into pressure cooker; mix well -pressure cook for 30 min until tender  Corn Salsa 🌽 Ingredients: -1 15-oz. can unsalted corn  -half of a red onion, diced  -1 jalapeño, diced  -salt, cilantro, and lime juice to taste  Instructions: -add ingredients into a bowl; mix well  Fresh Guacamole 🥑 Ingredients: -3 ripe avocados  -half a red onion, diced -1 roma tomato, diced -1 jalapeño, diced  -salt, cilantro, and lime juice to taste  Instructions: -add avocado to a bowl and mash; mix in rest of ingredients  -transfer to a container, press plastic wrap against the surface, and cover with a tight lid  Chipotle Honey Vinaigrette 🍯  Ingredients:  -1/3 cup olive oil  -1/4 cup honey  -1/4 cup red wine vinegar  -1/2 tsp garlic powder  -1/2 tsp dried oregano  -1/4 tsp salt -1/4 tsp pepper  -1 chipotle pepper from the can  Instructions: -add all the ingredients into a large container  -use an immersion blender to blend until smooth #mealprep #chipotle #chicken #food #cooking

Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

Most addictive snack in Italy 🇮🇹 Taralli are everywhere in Puglia, from restaurants and markets to gas stations. Made with just 4 ingredients, they’re crunchy and dangerously easy to eat. No table is complete without a basket of taralli and a bottle of wine🍷 INGREDIENTS 1000g 00 flour 360g dry white wine 220g extra virgin olive oil 20g sea salt Makes about 100 taralli. For different flavors, add fennel seeds, black pepper, rosemary, or chili flakes to the dough. DIRECTIONS 1. Add flour to a bowl and make a well. Mix wine, olive oil, and salt, pour into the center, and gradually incorporate the flour. 2. Knead for about 10 minutes until smooth, then rest for 10 minutes. 3. Roll small pieces into thin ropes and join the ends to form rings. 4. Boil in batches for about 1 minute, then drain on a clean cloth. 5. Transfer to a parchment-lined baking sheet and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25–30 minutes, until golden and crispy. #italianfood #easyrecipe #fy

Garlic Parmesan Sheet Pan Chicken and Veggies is an easy dinner my family loves!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken tenders 1/2 cup Parmesan Garlic sauce  14 oz pack kielbasa 1/2 lb Asparagus 24 oz baby potatoes, quartered  1 tbsp baking soda  Olive oil  Salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika  Parmesan cheese  Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Wash potatoes and cut them into quarters. Boil a pot of water and add 1 tbsp of baking soda (slowly so it doesn’t boil over). Add the potatoes to the boiling water. Boil for about 8 minutes or until the potatoes are almost fork tender. Drain potatoes.  Add the potatoes to a bowl and season with some olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. Toss potatoes until well coated.  Add potatoes to a sheet pan that has been sprayed with cooking spray.  Add washed/cut asparagus to the bowl and season with a little bit more of the same seasonings. Add asparagus to the sheet pan.  Cut the kielbasa up into rounds and add to the sheet pan.  Add your chicken to a bowl. Season chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. Add about 1/2 cup of Parmesan Garlic sauce over the chicken. Stir until well coated. Add to the sheet pan. Bake at 400 degrees for about 25 minutes.  Sometimes the chicken releases juice. Pour off any extra liquid and put the sheet pan back in the oven. Broil for just a few minutes. Top the chicken, potatoes, and asparagus with Parmesan cheese and dried parsley. Enjoy!  #easyrecipes #dinnerideas #sheetpanmeal

This Banana Omelet Tastes Like French Toast 🍳 🍌 ⸻ Ingredients ▶️ 1 ripe banana (120 g) ▶️ 2 large eggs ▶️ 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon ▶️ 1/2 tsp vanilla powder ▶️ Small pinch of sea salt ▶️ 1 tsp butter or extra-virgin olive oil (for the pan) ⸻ Preparation 1. Peel the banana and mash it in a bowl until mostly smooth. 2. Add the eggs, cinnamon, vanilla powder, and sea salt. 3. Whisk until well combined. 4. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat and lightly grease it with the butter or olive oil. 5. Pour the mixture into the skillet and spread it into an even circle. 6. Cook for 3–4 minutes, until the bottom is golden and the top is mostly set. 7. Carefully flip the omelet with a wide spatula and cook for another 2–3 minutes, until fully cooked through. 8. Fold the omelet in half and serve warm. ⸻ Tips (For Best Results) 💡 Use a ripe banana: The riper the banana, the sweeter and more French toast-like the flavor. 💡 Cook over medium-low heat: This allows the eggs to cook through without burning the banana. 💡 Mash the banana well: A smoother mixture creates a more even texture. 💡 Use a non-stick skillet: It makes flipping much easier. 💡 Flip gently: Wait until the omelet is mostly set before turning it over. 💡 Customize the toppings: Serve with fresh berries, Greek yogurt, chopped nuts, or a drizzle of honey. 💡 Enjoy immediately: The texture is best while warm. ⸻ Nutrition (1 omelet) ✅ Calories: ~260 kcal ✅ Protein: ~14 g ✅ Carbs: ~25 g ✅ Fat: ~11 g ✅ Fiber: ~3 g #bananaomelet #healthybreakfast #highproteinbreakfast #healthyfood #recipe

Meal prepping made easy  Here’s exactly how I keep it simple and stay consistent every week👇 4 lbs chicken thighs (bone-in or boneless) 1–2 bottles Veri Veri Teriyaki sauce Marinate 4+ hours (longer = better flavor) Smoke at 300° until internal hits 155°–165° Rest 5–10 minutes Chop it up → done That’s it. No fancy recipes. No guessing. No “what should I eat today?” Just repeatable meals that keep you on track.

⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per serving: Protein: 42g Carbs: 76g Fat: 8g Calories: 567 Ingredients per 2 servings: Rice Cooker - 12 oz chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 1.5 tsp salt - 1.5 tsp black pepper - 2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic - 2/3 cups jasmine rice, uncooked/raw - 1/3 cup chicken bone broth Japanese Cucumber Salad - 2 persian cucumbers - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds How to make it yourself: 1. Thinly slice your cucumbers and pat them dry. 2. In a bowl, mix together your chicken thighs, salt, black pepper, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic. 3. Wash your rice. 4. In a rice cooker, add your uncooked rice, chicken bone broth, and marinated chicken and let it cook for 30 minutes. 5. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 6. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 7. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 8. Once cooked, in a bowl, add half your rice, half of your chicken, half of your cucumber salad and enjoy! 📩 Save this one pot soy glazed chicken recipe to make for later and if you make it, post it and tag me in it! Oven-Baked Chicken with Potatoes and Creamy Paprika Sauce 🍗🥔 Tender chicken baked over a bed of golden potatoes and sweet onions, all coated in a rich paprika-infused sauce that turns beautifully caramelized in the oven. This comforting one-pan meal is perfect for busy weeknights and pairs wonderfully with a fresh salad and fluffy rice. Ingredients: 1 package of chicken cutlets 3 onions 6-7 potatoes - For the sauce; 1 tablespoon tomato paste Half a teacup of vegetable oil 1 teacup of milk Paprika powder, black pepper, thyme, salt Instructions; - Place the potatoes and onions in a baking dish. - Season them and add 4-5 tablespoons of vegetable oil, then mix. - Spread the mixture in the baking dish and arrange the chicken pieces. - Mix the sauce ingredients and spread it nicely over the chicken. Bake in a 190-degree oven until browned. 👉 Comment below: would you serve this with a fresh salad 🥗 or fluffy rice 🍚 on the side? 👇 #ovenbakedchicken #chickenandpotatoes #comfortfood #easyrecipes #familydinner
